question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a silver ball, Bob has a gold ball, Claire has a brown ball, Dave has a grey ball, Eve has a white ball, Fred has a pink ball, and Gertrude has a black ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Finally, Fred and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) silver ball
(B) gold ball
(C) brown ball
(D) grey ball
(E) white ball
(F) pink ball
(G) black ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: silver, gold, brown, grey, white, pink, black
1. Alice ↔ Bob: gold, silver, brown, grey, white, pink, black
2. Eve ↔ Claire: gold, silver, white, grey, brown, pink, black
3. Dave ↔ Bob: gold, grey, white, silver, brown, pink, black
4. Eve ↔ Dave: gold, grey, white, brown, silver, pink, black
5. Claire ↔ Eve: gold, grey, silver, brown, white, pink, black
6. Eve ↔ Claire: gold, grey, white, brown, silver, pink, black
7. Fred ↔ Alice: pink, grey, white, brown, silver, gold, black
Bob has the grey ball, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
